essence: The bīja klīṃ and the goddess Tripuṭeśānī protect the hands and bestow sovereignty over the three cities.
The bīja krauṃ and the three-syllabled goddess Bhuvaneśvarī protect the navel region.
The bīja hrīṃ and the salutation to Bhagavatī protect the secret region and the hip.
Annapūrṇā always protects, and svāhā protects the two feet.
The sixteen-syllabled mantra is composed beginning with tāraṃ, māyā, ramā, and kāmaḥ, with further elements following.
